🌟 Generous Donations is a game where you can donate and receive real Robux through in-game donations. All earned Robux are paid out through our Roblox group.
👥 Join our group to start earning:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/56253714/qtn

✨ Use code : RELEASE
✨ Next code at : 1k likes
💸 Donation Effects

• 5 Robux — Plane
• 10 Robux — Blimp
• 100 Robux — Nuke
• 1,000 Robux — Smite
• 10,000 Robux — Starfall

🎮 About the Game
This experience is a recreation of the classic donation game originally created by Haz3mn, inspired by an older version of the current game.
